title: Profiles
description: Who may change what (plan 02 D1): the profiles that own paths, and the classes of path no profile owns. Read by Noetic.Harness.Profiles, which `noetic-harness assign` uses to refuse an overlapping scope and `noetic-harness profiles --check` uses to name a tracked file nothing claims. What the schema cannot say, Profiles.validate/0 checks: every glob matches a tracked file, and no file is owned by two profiles unless `shared` says so.

glob.description: Root-relative. `**` crosses directory separators, `*` does not, and everything else is literal: the fence's semantics, so that a profile and the fence never read one glob two ways.

id.description: The value of HARNESS_AGENT in the profile's cloud environment, and the --agent of its WF-021 runs.

except.description: Paths inside `owns` that another profile owns instead.

environment.description: The cloud environment whose sessions work as this profile.

max_concurrent.description: How many sessions of this profile may hold an assignment at once.

held.description: Coordinator-held: an epic changes one only through a grant, and it lands only with --ack.

refused.description: No assignment may scope or grant these.

modifiable.description: The only keys an existing file's change may touch.

add_only.description: Any assignment may add files here; none may modify or delete one, except as `modifiable` allows.

per_epic.description: Paths with `{epic}` in them, writable only by the epic they name.

shared.description: Files two or more profiles own on purpose. Assignment still refuses two live epics on one of them.
